THE ORGANIZATION OFFERS A BONUS PLAN THAT PAYS A PERCENTAGE OF AN EMPLOYEE'S BASE PAY. THE INTENT OF THE PLAN IS TO REWARD AN EMPLOYEE'S PERFORMANCE TOWARDS ACHIEVEMENT OF STRATEGIC GOALS DURING THE FISCAL YEAR. SUCCESSFUL ACCOMPLISHMENT OF GOALS THAT CONTRIBUTE TO THE ORGANIZATION'S OVERALL STRATEGIC DIRECTION RESULT IN VARIABLE PAYMENTS ALIGNED WITH THE ORGANIZATION'S TOTAL COMPENSATION STRATEGY. THIS PROGRAM REWARDS EMPLOYEES BASED ON ORGANIZATIONAL PERFORMANCE MEASURES AND INDIVIDUAL EMPLOYEE GOAL PERFORMANCE. ALL PAYOUTS ARE CONTINGENT BASED ON THE UCHEALTH BOARD OF DIRECTORS APPROVAL EACH FISCAL YEAR.
